from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0093.png'))
# Chair is brown wood: col ~ 170 to 260
# Leg bottom pixels:
chair_mask = (img[:, :, 0] > 120) & (img[:, :, 1] > 60) & (img[:, :, 1] < 110) & (img[:, :, 2] < 50)
ys, xs = np.where(chair_mask)
print('Chair xs:', xs.min(), xs.max(), 'ys:', ys.min(), ys.max())
print('Chair leg contact row:', ys.max(), 'center x:', xs[ys == ys.max()].mean())

# Floor lamp base: dark grey
lamp_mask = (img[:, :, 0] < 80) & (img[:, :, 1] < 80) & (img[:, :, 2] > 70) & (img[:, :, 2] < 120)
# Look in right side
lamp_mask[:, :350] = False
ys_l, xs_l = np.where(lamp_mask)
if len(ys_l) > 0:
    print('Lamp base xs:', xs_l.min(), xs_l.max(), 'ys:', ys_l.min(), ys_l.max())
    print('Lamp base contact row:', ys_l.max(), 'center x:', xs_l[ys_l == ys_l.max()].mean())
"
